Reconstruct the visible indoor scene from one RGB photograph using SceneAct and Blender.
Infer geometry and a camera matching the reference viewpoint, perspective and framing.
Use separate 3D meshes for architecture, furniture and visible objects, preserving colors,
proportions, placement, occlusions and materials. Do not use the reference as a texture,
background or projected image. No ground-truth calibration or other views are available.

Return a complete, runnable Python program inside one ```python code block. Each execution
starts in a fresh Blender process. Programs can use numpy, sceneact and bpy. Use SceneAct
for geometry and relationships; bpy may customize lighting, materials and camera settings.
Do not render or save files in the program: the fixed runner saves and renders once after
execution, using your active camera. Do not access external files, network or other models.
When satisfied after inspecting a rendering, reply exactly DONE. The last successful build
is submitted automatically. Budget includes all planning, corrections and review calls.

SceneAct API (all coordinates in a world frame with Z up; angles in degrees):
from sceneact import *
Scene(name='Scene'), Asset(name='Asset'), Part(name, *nodes)
parent.include(name, node) attaches an asset/part while preserving its world position.
parent.members[name] retrieves a child; parent.remove(name) detaches it.
node.clone() returns an independent subtree. scene.replicate(name, new_name) duplicates an asset.
box(size=(x,y,z), center=(x,y,z), color=(r,g,b), opacity=1)
ball(radius, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1), opacity=1)
rod(radius, start=(x,y,z), end=(x,y,z), color=(1,1,1))
rod(radius, length=h, center=(0,0,0), axis='+z', color=(1,1,1))
fillet_box(size=(x,y,z), radius=r, center=(0,0,0), color=(1,1,1))
sweep_tube(points=[(x,y,z), ...], radius=.03, color=(1,1,1))
assemble(nodes, name='Assembly') groups shapes without merging their meshes.
fuse(*nodes), subtract(base,*cutters), overlap(*nodes), exclusive(left,right) construct solids.
node.move(offset), node.turn(axis, degrees, pivot=None), node.resize(factors, pivot=None)
modify a node and its descendants. node.turn(euler=(rx,ry,rz)) applies X, then Y, then Z.
Default rotation/scale pivot is the geometry's world-space bounding-box center.
shifted(node, offset), turned(node, axis, degrees, pivot=None, euler=None),
resized(node, factors, pivot=None) perform the same operations on independent copies.
node.paint(color, opacity=1) applies color to the subtree; node.rgba reads its finish.
node.centroid, node.dimensions, node.limits give AABB center, size, (minimum,maximum).
node.landmark('top'), node.landmark('front_left_bottom') return bounding-box anchors.
node.extreme(direction) returns a support point; projected_span(node,direction) returns bounds
along a unit direction; projected_width(node,direction) returns their difference.
snap(node, target, source_anchor='bottom', target_anchor='top', offset=(0,0,0)) returns a copy.
A target can also be a world point; then omit target_anchor.
abut(node, target, axis='+z', gap=0) places a copy after a target boundary.
center_on(node, target, axes=('x','y','z')) aligns selected center coordinates.
offset_at(node, reference, offsets) positions selected coordinates; None preserves a coordinate.
repeat_line(nodes, axis='+x', spacing=1) uses equal center spacing, keeping the first fixed.
pile(nodes, axis='+z', gap=0) spaces bounding surfaces, keeping the first fixed.
lattice(nodes, rows=None, columns=None, spacing=(1,1), plane='xy', center=(0,0,0), order='row-major')
orbit(nodes, radius, axis='+z', center=(0,0,0), start=0, sweep=360, orient=False, rotation_offset=0)
Layout functions return assemblies of independent copies.
scene.bind(source,target,source_anchor='bottom',target_anchor='top',offset=(0,0,0))
registers a persistent relation between scene members; scene.settle() updates dependencies.
realize(scene) settles constraints and creates Blender geometry, clearing Blender first.
set_view(position,target,lens=35,sensor=36,shift=(0,0)) creates the active camera.
area_emitter(position,power=500,size=5,target=(0,0,0),color=(1,1,1)) creates an area light.
Call realize before setting the camera and lighting. Estimate the input viewpoint yourself.

Example:
from sceneact import *
scene = Scene()
table = Asset('table')
table.include('top', box((1.4,.8,.08), center=(0,0,.75), color=(.4,.2,.1)))
for x in (-.6,.6):
    for y in (-.3,.3):
        table.include(f'leg_{x}_{y}', box((.07,.07,.7), center=(x,y,.35)))
scene.include('table', table)
scene.include('floor', box((6,6,.1), center=(0,0,-.05), color=(.6,.6,.6)))
realize(scene)
set_view((3,-4,2), (0,0,.7), lens=40)
area_emitter((0,-2,4), power=1000)

from sceneact import *
import bpy, math, random
from mathutils import Vector

scene = Scene("Train vestibule")
C = {
    "wall": (.57,.58,.55), "right": (.43,.47,.48),
    "steel": (.52,.56,.57), "dark": (.075,.095,.10),
    "orange": (.94,.34,.025), "yellow": (1,.55,.005),
    "blue": (.08,.27,.39)
}
def add(name, obj):
    scene.include(name, obj)
    return obj
def bx(name, size, center, color, radius=0):
    return add(name, fillet_box(size, radius, center=center, color=color)
               if radius else box(size, center=center, color=color))
def tube(name, points, radius=.018, color=None):
    return add(name, sweep_tube(points=points, radius=radius,
                                color=color or C["steel"]))
def line(name, a, b, radius=.015, color=None):
    return add(name, rod(radius, start=a, end=b, color=color or C["steel"]))
def loop(name, xmin, xmax, zmin, zmax, y, r=.10, thickness=.019, color=None):
    pts=[]
    for cx,cz,start in [(xmax-r,zmax-r,0),(xmin+r,zmax-r,90),
                        (xmin+r,zmin+r,180),(xmax-r,zmin+r,270)]:
        for i in range(9):
            t=math.radians(start+i*90/8)
            pts.append((cx+r*math.cos(t), y, cz+r*math.sin(t)))
    pts.append(pts[0])
    return tube(name,pts,thickness,color)

bx("right wall",(.13,5.7,3.0),(.73,.0,1.50),C["right"])
bx("ceiling",(4.5,6,.12),(-1.35,.2,3.02),(.48,.49,.46))
line("back horizontal seam",(-2.8,2.695,2.95),(.65,2.695,2.95),.006,(.24,.26,.25))
bx("corner post",(.105,.13,2.92),(.65,2.64,1.46),(.40,.43,.43),.018)
bx("right rear panel seam",(.008,.014,2.8),(.654,1.95,1.43),(.30,.34,.35))
bx("right forward seam",(.012,.018,2.95),(.653,-1.05,1.48),(.23,.27,.28))

# Deep, rounded window surround and a very bright exterior.

bx("window inner gasket",(1.525,.035,1.235),(-.76,2.600,1.86),(.12,.15,.16),.12)
bx("window daylight",(1.465,.025,1.175),(-.76,2.575,1.86),(.89,.95,.96),.105)
# Shapes seen through the glass, kept deliberately pale.
bx("outside white vehicle",(.58,.012,.50),(-.36,2.553,1.54),(.63,.72,.74),.055)
bx("outside dark window",(.51,.008,.28),(-.35,2.543,1.60),(.39,.51,.55),.025)

         (-.585+i*.077,2.531,1.73),.0035,(.63,.72,.74))
bx("outside red marking",(.26,.008,.035),(-.37,2.526,1.40),(.76,.32,.29))

for x in [-1.80,.23]:
    bx("yellow mounting plate"+str(x),(.065,.025,.15),(x,2.62,1.56),C["yellow"],.018)
    line("yellow mounting peg"+str(x),(x,2.63,1.56),(x,2.45,1.56),.026,C["yellow"])
line("window grab rail",(-1.84,2.44,1.56),(.27,2.44,1.56),.023,C["yellow"])

# Polished kick plate with perforated ventilation groups.
bx("back kick plate",(3.35,.065,.39),(-1.02,2.62,.235),(.49,.53,.53),.012)
bx("kickplate upper lip",(3.35,.09,.035),(-1.02,2.58,.445),(.66,.69,.68))
bx("kickplate lower lip",(3.35,.07,.035),(-1.02,2.57,.045),(.23,.27,.27))

    add("plate screw"+str(x),ball(.011,center=(x,2.57,.425),color=(.25,.28,.28)))

# Folded luggage/bicycle fittings on the end wall.
loop("upper rack outer",-1.08,.48,2.61,2.91,2.47,.13,.024,(.18,.21,.21))
line("upper rack inner rail",(-.94,2.43,2.73),(.34,2.43,2.73),.022,(.27,.30,.30))
line("upper rack silver rail",(-.92,2.45,2.86),(.33,2.45,2.86),.015,(.55,.58,.56))
for i,x in enumerate([-.83,-.27,.22]):
    tube("upper support"+str(i),[(x-.07,2.46,2.68),(x-.07,2.43,2.89),
         (x-.04,2.44,2.96),(x+.055,2.49,2.97),(x+.09,2.57,2.91)],

    tube("rack bent clip"+str(i),[(x-.06,2.47,.92),(x-.065,2.35,.91),
         (x-.06,2.34,.72),(x-.035,2.39,.62),(x+.035,2.48,.61),
         (x+.06,2.53,.67),(x+.05,2.53,.79)],.018,(.39,.43,.44))

bx("fold seat metal backing",(.095,.87,1.30),(.57,.84,1.45),(.39,.42,.41),.055)

for y in [.49,1.14]:
    tube("fold seat leg"+str(y),[(.49,y,1.00),(.46,y,.70),(.42,y,.60),
         (.42,y,.055),(.34,y,.04)],.026,(.48,.53,.54))
    bx("fold seat foot"+str(y),(.16,.12,.025),(.40,y,.025),(.43,.48,.49),.012)
tube("seat lower cross frame",[(.43,.48,.49),(.43,.48,.58),(.43,.57,.64),
     (.43,1.05,.64),(.43,1.14,.57),(.43,1.14,.49)],.023,(.37,.42,.43))
bx("fold release black handle",(.075,.13,.13),(.40,.40,1.19),(.035,.045,.045),.022)
tube("fold release cable",[(.405,.42,1.15),(.405,.39,.94),(.43,.43,.88)],

# The more distant adjacent orange backs.
for i,y in enumerate([1.28,1.67]):

    bx("adjacent grey shell"+str(i),(.08,.33,1.30),(-1.58,y,1.13),
       (.46,.50,.49),.05)
bx("front seat cushion",(1.22,.78,.20),(-1.28,-.79,.34),(.99,.40,.025),.10)
bx("front seat back",(.17,.73,1.18),(-1.83,-.75,.86),(.93,.34,.018),.085)
bx("front cushion grey base",(1.18,.72,.09),(-1.28,-.77,.21),(.32,.36,.36),.035)

bx("left upper handgrip pedestal",(.16,.14,.48),(-1.38,.20,1.89),(.29,.33,.34),.07)
tube("left yellow hand loop",[(-1.35,.18,1.89),(-1.35,.18,2.23),

     (-1.35,.40,1.97),(-1.35,.34,1.91),(-1.35,.18,1.89)],.025,C["yellow"])
line("left seat support",(-1.36,1.32,.50),(-1.36,1.32,.04),.026,(.41,.45,.45))

# Overhead left luggage shelf and a partial side window.
bx("left side wall",(.12,5.6,3.0),(-2.35,.05,1.50),(.55,.56,.52))
bx("left window black surround",(.045,1.60,1.62),(-2.27,1.03,1.85),(.06,.075,.075),.10)
bx("left window light",(.025,1.46,1.47),(-2.24,1.03,1.85),(.85,.92,.93),.08)

bx("shelf front fascia",(.06,1.90,.21),(-1.44,1.58,2.81),(.28,.30,.28),.012)
for j in range(12):
    y=.72+j*.15
    line("luggage shelf slat"+str(j),(-2.32,y,2.80),(-1.47,y,2.80),.018,(.50,.52,.48))
line("shelf bracket",(-1.46,2.46,2.74),(-1.46,2.46,2.98),.022,(.34,.36,.33))

# Material finish, subtle surface grain and soft daylight.
for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects:
    if obj.type != 'MESH':
        continue
    for mat in obj.data.materials:
        if not mat:
            continue
        mat.use_nodes=True
        bs=mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
        if bs:
            bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.55
            name=obj.name.lower()
            if any(s in name for s in ["rail","rack","leg","steel","plate","shelf slat"]):
                bs.inputs["Metallic"].default_value=.60
                bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.32
            if "orange" in name or "cushion" in name:
                bs.inputs["Roughness"].default_value=.66
            if "daylight" in name or "left window light" in name:
                bs.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value=(.78,.87,.90,1)
                bs.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value=.55
            if name == "floor":
                nodes=mat.node_tree.nodes
                noise=nodes.new("ShaderNodeTexNoise")
                noise.inputs["Scale"].default_value=180
                noise.inputs["Detail"].default_value=2
                ramp=nodes.new("ShaderNodeValToRGB")
                ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color=(.016,.021,.021,1)
                ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color=(.095,.105,.103,1)
                mat.node_tree.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],ramp.inputs["Fac"])
                mat.node_tree.links.new(ramp.outputs["Color"],bs.inputs["Base Color"])
                bump=nodes.new("ShaderNodeBump")
                bump.inputs["Strength"].default_value=.16
                bump.inputs["Distance"].default_value=.008
                mat.node_tree.links.new(noise.outputs["Fac"],bump.inputs["Height"])
                mat.node_tree.links.new(bump.outputs["Normal"],bs.inputs["Normal"])

world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[0].default_value=(.53,.59,.63,1)
world.node_tree.nodes["Background"].inputs[1].default_value=.33

sc.cycles.samples=48
sc.cycles.use_denoising=True
sc.render.resolution_x=512
sc.render.resolution_y=342
sc.render.resolution_percentage=100
sc.view_settings.view_transform='AgX'
sc.view_settings.look='AgX - Medium High Contrast'
sc.view_settings.exposure=.25
